en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small village nestled in a forested valley with hills in the background. Traditional timber and stone houses line a narrow road running up the slope. Dense trees surround the settlement, and on the upper right stands a prominent church with a tall steeple at the edge of the forest. Printed German text appears at the top and along the left edge.
